locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: This module is valid for the whole corresponding region. Some agents used like lime or sodium cyanide originate from data sets valid for Switzerland or Europe.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
The ore is pre-treated, reduced and refined according to the country specific mix of process alternatives: reverberatory furnace 6.2%; flash smelting furnaces 76%; other 17.8%. An overall abatement for sulphur dioxide of 95% was estimated.

# Included processes
The module includes the pre-treatment of the ore, reduction and refining of copper cathodes in RER. It does NOT include the mining and beneficiation step.
